Metadata.title: Parkfairy
Metadata.description: Find and book parking ahead of time.

Home.title: Parking, booked before you arrive.
Home.lead: Reserve a spot at garages and private spaces near where you are going, with the full price shown up front.
Home.featuredLead: Garages and private spaces you can compare right now.

search.title: Search
search.text: Pick an area or use your location, then choose when you arrive and when you leave.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See opening hours, free spaces and the full price for your stay before you go.

park.title: Park
park.text: Head to your named space. Online booking is coming soon.

Home.accountText: Create a free account to be ready when online booking opens.

SignUp.title: Create your account
SignUp.description: Book parking and manage your reservations.
SignUp.name: Name
SignUp.sentBody: We’ve sent an email to {email}. Follow the link in it to continue. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
SignUp.sentHint: Nothing there? Check your spam folder, or send it again.

TwoFactor.title: Two-factor verification
TwoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.backupDescription: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-factor authentication. Each one works once.

Account.checking: Checking your session with the API…
Account.apiError: The API could not verify your session.

TwoFactorSettings.heading: Two-factor authentication
TwoFactorSettings.intro: Protect your account: signing in will need a code from an authenticator app as well as your password.
TwoFactorSettings.statusOn: On. Signing in needs a code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactorSettings.statusOff: Off. Signing in needs only your password.
TwoFactorSettings.confirmText: Enter your password to change your security settings.
TwoFactorSettings.scanHeading: Add Parkfairy to your authenticator app
TwoFactorSettings.scanText: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or type in the key below. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
TwoFactorSettings.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
TwoFactorSettings.manualKey: Key for typing in by hand
TwoFactorSettings.backupText: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. Store them somewhere safe: they won’t be shown again.

ForgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
ForgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sentBody: If there’s an account for {email}, we’ve sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: You’ll be signed out everywhere, and can then sign in with the new password.
ResetPassword.doneBody: Your new password is ready to use.
ResetPassword.invalidBody: It has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.

VerifyEmail.confirmedBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
VerifyEmail.failedBody: Enter your email and we’ll send you a new link.
VerifyEmail.requestBody: Enter your email and we’ll send you a confirmation link.
VerifyEmail.sentBody: If {email} still needs confirming, we’ve sent it a new link. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
VerifyEmail.confirmBody: Press the button to finish creating your account. If you didn’t sign up for Parkfairy, just close this page.

Email.footer: Parkfairy. You’re receiving this because this address was used on our site.
Email.linkFallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Confirm this address to finish creating your Parkfairy account. The link works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
verifyEmail.note: If you didn’t create an account, ignore this email and nothing will happen.

resetPassword.subject: Choose a new password
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.body: A password reset was requested for your Parkfairy account. The link works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and only once.
resetPassword.note: If this wasn’t you, ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your Parkfairy account was just changed, and every device was signed out.
passwordChanged.note: If this was you, there’s nothing more to do. If not, choose a new password now.

existingAccount.subject: You already have a Parkfairy account
existingAccount.heading: You already have an account
existingAccount.body: Someone tried to create a Parkfairy account with this address, but it already has one.
existingAccount.note: If that was you and you’ve forgotten your password, use the link in this email. If not, ignore this email: nothing has changed.
